mechanismOfAction.summary: α1(BZ1)-selective partial agonist at the GABA-A benzodiazepine binding site; triazolopyridazine scaffold (NOT a benzodiazepine structurally). Historical tool compound for dissecting α1-mediated sedation from α2-mediated anxiolysis.
mechanismOfAction.description: Triazolopyridazine (not a benzodiazepine). Historically used as a research tool to pharmacologically dissect α1 (BZ1)-mediated sedation/amnesia from α2 (BZ2)-mediated anxiolysis — preceding zolpidem as a selective α1 tool. Zolpidem-like selectivity profile but lower maximal efficacy (partial agonism). No human studies.
